## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Logic lives in a CommonJS helper with a `node:test` test; `index.ts` only wires Pi
- [ ] The extension folder stays self-contained (no imports from outside it)
- [ ] README of the touched extension is updated (Install / Usage / Config / How it works / Limits)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
- [ ] Tried against a real Pi with an isolated `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` (see CONTRIBUTING.md), or said below why not
